title: Bitcoin Spot ETF (US Regulated)
summary: SEC-approved Bitcoin spot ETF enabling institutional allocation — Jan 2024
bodyHtml:
What This Is

SEC-approved Bitcoin spot ETF enabling institutional allocation — Jan 2024. Achieved.

Deployed at commercial scale with multiple competing vendors. Revenue-generating across the industry. Our research database tracks 2 independent sources on this technology.

SEC approved 11 spot Bitcoin ETFs January 2024; BlackRock IBIT surpassed $50B AUM by late 2025 with daily volumes exceeding $2B. Options on IBIT approved September 2024. Ethereum spot ETFs approved July 2024. Fully integrated into traditional finance infrastructure.
